title: Path-preserving balance-threshold tomography at G21J convergence splits
question: What binary64 tolerance threshold corresponds to the identified B2 total-balance blocker and B1 compartment-balance blocker, when only path-preserving diagnostic interventions are admitted?

cases.other_tolerances: HEAD, TOTAL and POND fixed at diagnostic 1e6; compartment starts at frozen 1e-12
cases.search_event: physical solver converges OR backtracking changes from 8
cases.path_guard: a convergence threshold is authoritative only when backtracking remains exactly 8

search_contract: Every evaluation is a fresh immutable-origin raw backend solve with max_retries=0 and copied corrector parameters/configuration.
At the case baseline require physical nonconvergence and the preregistered backtracking count.
Starting from 1e-12, double only the target tolerance until the case search event occurs or 60 doublings are exhausted.
Once bracketed, binary-search in ordinary binary64 arithmetic between the last no-event tolerance and first event tolerance. Stop when math.nextafter(low,+inf) >= high or after 128 bisections.
For B2, any backtracking count other than 3 at any evaluated tolerance invalidates path-preserving interpretation.

For B1, HEAD/TOTAL/POND remain fixed at 1e6 throughout the search. If the first binary64 event tolerance changes backtracking before physical convergence, classify the original-path compartment threshold as occluded by its dual role in backtracking.

If B1 first event is physical convergence with backtracking still 8, the adjacent [largest fail, smallest pass] binary64 tolerances bracket the maximum compartment residual at the original iteration-4 state.

For B2, because TOTAL is not used in the backtracking acceptance test and G21J established it as the sole minimal primary blocker, the adjacent [largest fail, smallest pass] tolerances bracket abs(sum(residual)) at the original iteration-3 state.
No tolerance value from this diagnostic becomes a proposed runtime tolerance.

classifications.B2_TOTAL_THRESHOLD_RESOLVED: Adjacent binary64 fail/pass total tolerances found with backtracking exactly 3.
classifications.B2_PATH_INTERFERENCE: Any total-tolerance arm changes backtracking or fails monotonic physical convergence.
classifications.B1_COMPARTMENT_THRESHOLD_RESOLVED_PATH_P: Adjacent binary64 fail/pass compartment tolerances found and both retain backtracking exactly 8.
classifications.B1_COMPARTMENT_THRESHOLD_OCCLUDED_BY_BAC: The first tolerance event changes backtracking before a same-path convergence threshold can be established.
classifications.B1_SEARCH_UNRESOLVED: No event bracket or nonmonotonic event behavior.

gates: G21J baseline classifications reproduce before threshold search.
B2 search never changes backtracking from 3.
B2 bracket terminates at adjacent binary64 tolerance values and low fails/high converges.
B1 noncompartment-relaxed baseline still fails with exactly 8 backtracking attempts.
B1 result is classified strictly by the preregistered event rule; no tolerance is selected post hoc.
Saved corrector parameters/configuration remain unchanged, proven by normal G16 [6,0,0,6] postcondition.
Accepted revision/time/ledger and participant/G16 publication authority remain unchanged.
pass_interpretation: PASS yields diagnostic numerical magnitudes for the existing balance predicates. It does not justify relaxing tolerances or changing acceptance policy.
fail_interpretation: Preserve unresolved/path-interfering outcomes. Do not expose production scratch, weaken criteria or choose a tolerance for operational robustness.
